title: SearchKey::Since/Before silently produce wrong query
description: SearchKey::Since and SearchKey::Before are parsed from NNTP SEARCH commands but handled in handle_nntp_search by passing the date string as a bare free-text query to Tantivy. This produces a text search for the date string literal instead of a date-range query. SEARCH SINCE 'Mon 01 Jan 2024' returns articles containing the words 'Mon', '01', 'Jan', '2024' rather than articles since that date. The Since/Before variants should either perform a proper date range query or return 501 Not Implemented.
